functions.name: add_standing
functions.doc: Locks `amount × notice_periods` into committed notice. Returns the new id.

functions.name: approve
functions.doc: Medium payouts only. The first approval releases the payout.

functions.name: cancel_payout
functions.doc: The filer or the DAO may withdraw a Waiting payout; the deposit is refunded.

functions.name: escalate
functions.doc:
Medium past its timeout, or an Objected payout with `needs_manual_filing`
 (retry after the bond float is topped up) → files the DAO proposal.

type_schema.description:
NEAR Account Identifier.

This is a unique, syntactically valid, human-readable account identifier on the NEAR network.

[See the crate-level docs for information about validation.](index.html#account-id-rules)

Also see [Error kind precedence](AccountId#error-kind-precedence).

## Examples

``` use near_account_id::AccountId;

let alice: AccountId = "alice.near".parse().unwrap();

assert!("ƒelicia.near".parse::<AccountId>().is_err()); // (ƒ is not f) ```

functions.name: ft_on_transfer
functions.doc:
NEP-141 receiver. Only the DAO may fund; anything else is refunded in full.
 `msg`: `"fund"` | `"fund_standing:<id>"`.

functions.name: pay_due
functions.doc: Pays every due period up to now. Returns `None` when nothing is due.

functions.name: release
functions.doc: Small, Waiting, window passed → Sending → transfer → `on_sent`.

functions.name: remove_lane
functions.doc: Fails while the lane has Waiting payouts.

functions.name: set_bond_float
functions.doc: Sets how much of the instance's NEAR is kept aside for escalation bonds.

functions.name: set_record_steps
functions.doc: Per lane, because steps are in that lane's token units.

functions.name: settle_escalation
functions.doc: Reads the escalated proposal; records a point if Approved.

functions.name: stop_standing
functions.doc: Starts the notice period; remaining payments come from committed notice.

functions.name: sync_council
functions.doc: Reads the DAO policy; council = members of roles with `transfer:VoteApprove`.

functions.name: withdraw
functions.doc: Only from `available` (I2: committed notice is untouchable, even by the DAO).
